_description: BMP effectiveness rates from literature review. All values are proportional reduction (0-1).
_sources: Liu et al. 2019 - Cover crops and P losses in cold climates
PMC 2024 - Effectiveness of residue and tillage management
Ohio State - Subsurface P placement studies
2025 Canadian Lake Erie BMP literature review

type_a_particulate_p_reduction._description: Surface protection BMPs: reduction in particulate phosphorus

type_b_dissolved_p_reduction._description: Fertilizer management BMPs: reduction in dissolved reactive phosphorus

particulate_to_total_p_ratio._description: Fraction of total P that is particulate (rest is dissolved)

base_p_loss_kg_per_acre_per_year._description: Baseline annual phosphorus loss without any BMP, by risk level
base_p_loss_kg_per_acre_per_year._validation: 620,000 acres * 0.5 avg = 310 tonnes, close to observed ~300 tonnes/yr
